\u0026nbsp;On presentation she had hb-4.5 gm\/dl .\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nAfter\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n1 st blood transfusion On12\/05\/20 hb:6.2 gm\/dl\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; margin-right: 1em; text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Cimg border=\"0\" data-original-height=\"555\" data-original-width=\"1152\" height=\"154\" src=\"https:\/\/blogger.googleusercontent.com\/img\/b\/R29vZ2xl\/AVvXsEiLm46YQG0oYuQIyiNsIY7_BgHpgzmN9p8v_fIetnKbiXgHXI8LYtEp5mm30CrxXsiGec4SEZk_QZAXWysYxFte3HUHAhw1mK1cuPT_ms7xTbZQb2LE88UlY_aogljnv88e22-XdViaHWbg\/s320\/A1484F3E-5523-42CB-824A-F7EBBAF01B15.jpeg\" width=\"320\" \/\u003E\u003C\/a\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nRBC:hypochromic with anisopoikilocytosis comprising normocytes ,macrocytes ,tear drop cells,schistocytes, ,polychromasia and nucleated rbcs 2-3 \/ 100 wbc\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nWBC: normal count with hypersegmented neutrophils and mild shift to left\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nPlatelets: adequate\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nNo parasites\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nImpression: normocytic hypochromic anemia with hypersegmented neutrophils\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;-? Megaloblastic anemia\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; -? Hemolytic anemia\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nOsmotic fragility-lysis starts at 0.45%\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; Completes at 0.33%\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nStool culture: no pus cells,no rbcs, no parasitic forms of ova \/ cyst seen\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nStool for occult blood: positive\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nSerology is negative\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nDirect coombs test negative\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nIndirect coombs test POSITIVE\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nUSG abdomen-splenomegaly\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; Fibroid uterus\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; Right hydrosalpinx\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n2d echo: mild dilated R.A\/ R.V\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nPROCEDURE LEARNT: BONE MARROW ASPIRATION ( site- sternum) done on 13\/05\/20\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nFirst consent was taken from the patient for the procedure and the pt didn’t agree for video recording of the procedure. Then the patient was given a test dose of xylocaine. After half and hour at the level of 2 nd intercoastal space 10ml xylocaine was given then marrow was Aspirated.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003E\n\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/blogger.googleusercontent.com\/img\/b\/R29vZ2xl\/AVvXsEhuINHN85wViq-BIQs7ufjrPBYz4ZEiSVqDeWTJx6bbDlI6FJiSWjDImbSFRI4v4om4fBYzzLIBdGfVIo32YqPMA33HNSpx_Nf43lREW8a5R_Ga093rEHQTer2u5f6iKrsOMObMTRv2GXcP\/s1600\/AB107071-15E0-434E-BBF1-140E30B483B1.jpeg\" imageanchor=\"1\" style=\"margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;\"\u003E\u003Cimg border=\"0\" data-original-height=\"1280\" data-original-width=\"960\" height=\"320\" src=\"https:\/\/blogger.googleusercontent.com\/img\/b\/R29vZ2xl\/AVvXsEhuINHN85wViq-BIQs7ufjrPBYz4ZEiSVqDeWTJx6bbDlI6FJiSWjDImbSFRI4v4om4fBYzzLIBdGfVIo32YqPMA33HNSpx_Nf43lREW8a5R_Ga093rEHQTer2u5f6iKrsOMObMTRv2GXcP\/s320\/AB107071-15E0-434E-BBF1-140E30B483B1.jpeg\" width=\"240\" \/\u003E\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u0026nbsp; Report: reactive marrow with erythroid hyperplasia\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u0026nbsp; \u003Cbr \/\u003E\nDIAGNOSIS:\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; ?megaloblastic anemia\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;?hemolytic anemia\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nTREATMENT GIVEN:\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nPlanned for 2 prbc blood transfusion\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nInj. Vitcofol 2cc\/im\/od (D 3\/5)\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nT.livogen \u0026nbsp;150mg\/po\/od for 1 month\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nT.MVT\/po\/od\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nInj methylcobalamine \u0026nbsp;1 amp\/im\/od 500 mcg for 5 days (D1\/5)\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nADVICE AT DISCHARGE:\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nInj. Hydroxocobalamin 1000 mcg for 3 days. Followed with weekly once for 1 month. Later on monthly once for 2 months\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nT. MVT po od for 1\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nTopic learnt today : myelodysplastic syndrome\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n(MDS)Myelodysplastic syndrome is a clonal hematopoietic stem cell disorder characterised by morphological dysplastic changes in one or more of major hematopoietic cell lines.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nMDS can be presented with cytopenias - neutropenia, anemia and thrombocytopenia.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nFAB classification was recommended early and as modified by WHO .\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nWHO uses percentage of blasts in bone marrow, ring sideroblasts and dysplastic changes to differentiate MDS subtypes.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n1. Refractory anemia\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n2.refractory anemia with ringed sideroblasts\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n3. Refractory cytopenia with multilineage dysplasia\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n4. Refractory cytopenia with multilineage dysplasia and ringed sideroblasts\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n5.refractory anemia with excess blasts\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n6.myelodysplastic syndrome unclassified\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n7. MDS with isolated del (5q)\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nSome of the cytopenic causes are:\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nA.Chronic liver disease\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nB.drug induced cytopenia\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nC.excessive alcohol intake\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nD.b12\/folate deficiency\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nE.autoimmune cytopenia\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nF. Anemia of chronic disorders\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nG . Parasitic infections\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nStem cell disorders like IDUS,ICUS ,CCUS,CHIP\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/blogger.googleusercontent.com\/img\/b\/R29vZ2xl\/AVvXsEg4wHzj3wxOheigIMpfF8fdFCEW4YcxweS7YCo-aFLGE_4ejMWx1FKvxeTAtMxdxedFkoT5b8enHiPUl9oD2tiz0iXMgcdBjcnzqELB3d5UgE8hsibfH9_4mULmbglgrJwMU_yecA2E6pln\/s1600\/22A117C5-5A05-4226-8981-ACC133385219.jpeg\" imageanchor=\"1\" style=\"margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em; text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Cimg border=\"0\" data-original-height=\"1477\" data-original-width=\"1125\" height=\"320\" src=\"https:\/\/blogger.googleusercontent.com\/img\/b\/R29vZ2xl\/AVvXsEg4wHzj3wxOheigIMpfF8fdFCEW4YcxweS7YCo-aFLGE_4ejMWx1FKvxeTAtMxdxedFkoT5b8enHiPUl9oD2tiz0iXMgcdBjcnzqELB3d5UgE8hsibfH9_4mULmbglgrJwMU_yecA2E6pln\/s320\/22A117C5-5A05-4226-8981-ACC133385219.jpeg\" width=\"243\" \/\u003E\u003C\/a\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nIntext source\u0026nbsp;\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/www.intechopen.com\/books\/recent-developments-in-myelodysplastic-syndromes\/diagnosis-and-classification-of-myelodysplastic-syndrome\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/www.intechopen.com\/books\/recent-developments-in-myelodysplastic-syndromes\/diagnosis-and-classification-of-myelodysplastic-syndrome\u003C\/a\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nClinical presentation : infection,bleeding\/bruising ,gum bleeding,petechiae\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nSymptoms include general weakness, pallor,shirtness of breath\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nOn physical examination enlarged spleen size.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nInvestigations : complete blood picture,serum ferritin, serum iron,stool culture,2d echo,USG abdomen, bone marrow aspiration.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nDysplastic changes include :\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nDyserythropoiesis\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nDysmyelopoiesis\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nDysmegakaryopoiesis\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nTreatment\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nBlood transfusion\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nChemotherapy\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nHormone replacement therapy\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nBone marrow transplant\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003E\n\u003C\/div\u003E\n\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\n\u003C\/div\u003E\n"},"link":[{"rel":"replies","type":"application/atom+xml","href":"https:\/\/soundarya1206.blogspot.com\/feeds\/1607934835012721174\/comments\/default","title":"Post Comments"},{"rel":"replies","type":"text/html","href":"https:\/\/soundarya1206.blogspot.com\/2020\/05\/hello-all-im-intern-and-here-is-case.html#comment-form","title":"0 Comments"},{"rel":"edit","type":"application/atom+xml","href":"https:\/\/www.blogger.com\/feeds\/4263448913741180786\/posts\/default\/1607934835012721174"},{"rel":"self","type":"application/atom+xml","href":"https:\/\/www.blogger.com\/feeds\/4263448913741180786\/posts\/default\/1607934835012721174"},{"rel":"alternate","type":"text/html","href":"https:\/\/soundarya1206.blogspot.com\/2020\/05\/hello-all-im-intern-and-here-is-case.html","title":""}],"author":[{"name":{"$t":"Soundarya 12"},"uri":{"$t":"http:\/\/www.blogger.com\/profile\/16769577508964305579"},"email":{"$t":"noreply@blogger.com"},"gd$image":{"rel":"http://schemas.google.com/g/2005#thumbnail","width":"16","height":"16","src":"https:\/\/img1.blogblog.com\/img\/b16-rounded.gif"}}],"media$thumbnail":{"xmlns$media":"http://search.yahoo.com/mrss/","url":"https:\/\/blogger.googleusercontent.com\/img\/b\/R29vZ2xl\/AVvXsEiLm46YQG0oYuQIyiNsIY7_BgHpgzmN9p8v_fIetnKbiXgHXI8LYtEp5mm30CrxXsiGec4SEZk_QZAXWysYxFte3HUHAhw1mK1cuPT_ms7xTbZQb2LE88UlY_aogljnv88e22-XdViaHWbg\/s72-c\/A1484F3E-5523-42CB-824A-F7EBBAF01B15.jpeg","height":"72","width":"72"},"thr$total":{"$t":"0"}}]}}
